CustomField.description: Displays a green Active flag when today is between Start Date and End Date (inclusive) and Date Access Removed is blank, using the Active static resource. Otherwise displays a red Inactive flag (Inactive static resource), including when either date is blank.
CustomField.formula: IF( AND( NOT( ISBLANK( Start_Date__c ) ), NOT( ISBLANK( End_Date__c ) ), TODAY() >= Start_Date__c, TODAY() <= End_Date__c, ISBLANK( Date_Access_Removed__c ) ), IMAGE("/resource/Active", "Active", 20, 60), IMAGE("/resource/Inactive", "Inactive", 20, 69) )
CustomField.label: Active
